resources.string: This app is getting ready for your classroom. Hub connection and saved lessons will be available in a later update.
Your classes will appear here after account setup and connection to your classroom Hub are available.
L.A.R.A. brings lessons and classroom activities to your device. This version sets up the app; account setup and classroom features are coming later.
AI Tutor is unavailable while a quiz is in progress.
Hub unreachable. Showing what is saved on this device.
AI is not available right now.
Ask your teacher for the address shown on the Hub computer.
Checking: Please wait while we reach your Hub.
Check the address: Copy the numbers and optional port from your teacher, such as 192.168.1.50:8080.
Hub unavailable: Check the address with your teacher and try again.
Hub responding: The download page is reachable.
Hub disconnected: Join your classroom Wi-Fi, or enter the Hub address below.
Discovery interrupted: You can still enter the Hub address or try scanning again.
Searching: Looking for your classroom Hub.
No Hubs yet. Try scanning again or ask your teacher for the address.
Hubs found: Choose your classroom Hub below.
Learners can register here. Ask your Hub administrator for a teacher account.
Signing in to your classroom Hub...
Check your details: Enter your ID and four PIN digits. Learner registration needs a 12-digit LRN and full name.
Connect to a Hub: Choose Find classroom Hub below before signing in.
Try again: Your ID or PIN did not match. Check them with your teacher if you need help.
Hub account: Administrators sign in on the Hub computer.
Account unavailable: This learner may already be registered, or this device has another saved account. Ask your teacher for help.
Please wait: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
Hub unreachable: Check the classroom Wi-Fi or use Find classroom Hub. Saved classroom work stays on this device.
Could not sign in: Please try again or ask your teacher for help.
Saved session unavailable: Sign in again to reopen your classroom.
